Connection target
Choose which BiBi Keyboard build the module connects to.
Auto (prefer Pro)
BiBi Keyboard Pro
BiBi Keyboard open source
Change connection target
Manual targets never fall back. If the selected build is unavailable, PCM and clipboard bridge requests fail.
Auto prefers BiBi Keyboard Pro and falls back to the open-source build. Manual Pro or open-source targets do not fall back.
Show touch area
Inject the waveform and touch area into hooked keyboards. Use it to record or to switch input methods.
Stops injecting the waveform and touch area. Text insertion, IME visibility, and clipboard bridging stay available.
Shows the waveform and touch area at the bottom of hooked keyboards. You can use it for recording or for switching to another input method. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
Show waveform only while recording
Hide the idle waveform without disabling the touch area.
Keeps the waveform visible while idle and recording.
Hides the waveform while idle. The touch area stays active, and the waveform appears during recording. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
Tap to start and stop recording
Use two taps instead of holding the touch area.
Hold the touch area to start, then release to finish. Moving outside the area cancels recording.
Tap once to start recording and tap again to finish. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
Long-press to switch input method
Hold the touch area to switch to another input method instead of recording.
The touch area continues to start and stop recording.

Holding the touch area switches to the selected input method and no longer starts recording. Tap-to-toggle recording is unavailable in this mode. The target input method must already be enabled in system settings. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
Other input method
Choose the input method to switch to after a long-press.
Select an input method
Select an input method in the bridge settings first
Unable to switch input method. Enable it in system settings and try again
Hide waveform by default
Hide the idle waveform. The touch area stays available for long-press switching.
Keeps the idle waveform visible in switch-IME mode so the touch area is easier to find.

Hides the waveform and touch-area appearance. Long-press switching still works. This setting is independent of Show waveform only while recording. Changes apply the next time the keyboard window is shown.
